remix.rule: The shipped film states no figures, because these are demonstrations rather than results. Substitute real numbers only if you can stand behind them — a personalised demo carries more weight, which is exactly why an invented number in one does more damage.

approval.note: A storyboard is a script, not footage. Every claim is qualitative rather than invented — a demo that fabricates a metric teaches the viewer something false, so this script says an agent accelerates a task and never says by how much. A human approves the script before anything is rendered.

scenes.narration: But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand. Now, with unified data context across Dynamics 365 Commerce and Microsoft Teams, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary. It is explicit about what it did not read, so nobody mistakes a gap in the sources for a clean result. It names what it needs from a person before anything is written back, and who owns each step. And it says what would change its answer, which is the difference between a briefing you can act on and one you have to re-check. It can reduce overstock in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on.
The result?, prevent stockouts, reduce overstock, and better maximize omnichannel retail performance. Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
